mechanism: Probenecid competitively inhibits the renal tubular secretion of pyrazinamide, reducing its clearance and increasing serum concentrations, while pyrazinamide antagonizes the uricosuric effect of probenecid.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if co-administration is necessary, monitor pyrazinamide levels and renal function closely, and consider alternative antituberculous or urate-lowering agents.
